senses.gloss: m. pl. (an adaptation of pegma, as if fr. פָּגַם) [the things which impair a Jew’s civic qualifications,] a wooden structure for spectacles (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Pegma).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:7:4">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 7:4:3">Y. Shebu. VII, 37ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אין מקבלין אותו עד שישבר פְּגִימָיו וכ׳</he> (the exhibitor of pigeon-races or beast-fights) is not declared free from disqualifications, until he breaks up his scenery, and he is examined and found to have really repented; <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 5:2">Tosef. Snh. V, 2</cite> <he>פגימיו</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>פִּיגְמָיו</he>); Bab.
